stem: Which sentence best states the main idea of the article?

options.label: A
options.text: A truck driver from Chicago was the champion of the pit spit in Eau Claire in 2012.

options.label: B
options.text: The pit spit, which features many eager participants, will be taking place again at the Tree-Mendus Fruit Farm in Eau Claire.

options.label: C
options.text: Although last year's cold weather kept the cherry harvest small, this year the harvest will be ideal for the pit spit.

options.label: D
